notes: Initial repository dataset: 10 positions, 20 screenshots. Captured on 2026-09-29 and adopted unchanged from the pilot after review. Positions were selected or constructed, not sampled from a game corpus; includes empty-board and corner diagnostics without legality requirements. Splits were assigned before capture. Evaluation images have been used only to check capture/annotation correctness, not to tune recognition. This small, fixed-layout set does not establish recognition accuracy or provide sufficient training diversity.

review.method: Visual inspection of all 20 screenshots against piece placement, orientation and visible grid extent; automated checks of file hashes, dimensions, annotations and split consistency. DOM-derived fractional bounds are retained, not independently measured to subpixel precision.
